To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) a segmented-IAA-based approach can be used for estimating the auto- and the cross-covariance of unevenly sampled sequences; 2) this segmented-IAA approach can be used to improve the MSC estimation accuracy of the Capon-based MSC estimators; and 3) the proposed SIAA-MSCE estimator can provide high resolution estimates of the coherence spectrum of unevenly sampled signals.

(a) we develop a non-parametrical, iterative, Capon-based MSC estimation method that is suitable for unevenly sampled sequences; (b) our proposed SIAA- MSC method is shown to provide better MSC estimates as compared to a more commonly used MSC estimator; and (c) we show that SIAA-MSE can provide improved performance even in cases where the underlying signal is non-stationary.
